messages:
vivian: Quick debrief from today's Tempest perf run — attaching results summary.
aj: Thanks — can we get p95/p99 numbers and the exact load pattern used?
sam: Ran 30m soak + 10m burst. Model: redwood-3b-quant. Sustained QPS 240, concurrency target 32. p95=120ms p99=310ms, tail spikes during bursts to ~620ms. GPU/mem graphs attached.
luis: GPU util ~78% avg, memory ~80%, batching averaged 18 tokens per batch. KV cache hit ~12% due to prompt variety.
jordan_tempest: Thanks — for pricing calc can you provide tokens/sec and cost estimate for 50k daily requests with similar mix?
vivian: Ballpark: at current config about $0.012 per 1k tokens (hosted) => roughly $3.5k/mo for their expected volume. I'll drop the spreadsheet.
rahul: Security note: KMS unwrap adds ~5-8ms per request if envelope keys used. HSM path adds extra latency and may reduce peak QPS. We'll include SOC2/KMS docs.
aj: Action items: 1) rerun burst with prewarmed KV cache (repeat queries). 2) try batch cap 24 and measure latency. 3) export CSV with per-minute p50/p95/p99.
sam: Scheduling rerun tonight. Command used: ```perf-run --model redwood-3b-quant --duration 1800 --pattern poisson --qps 240 --burst 1200 --concurrency 32 --warmup 300 --kv-cache true```
perf-bot: perf-run job #4723 started on pool ded-3b-quant at 2026-03-20T23:02:10Z
luis: FYI we had one routing fallback during the 10m burst (region mismatch). Fallback served an older model variant with higher latency — recommend pinning model version or accept occasional degraded latency.
jordan_tempest: Can you confirm SLA impact for fallback? Also need SOC2 section on key management.
rahul: For strict latency SLOs enable config 'no-fallback' which will return 429 when capacity exhausted. For guaranteed availability use fallback but expect higher tails. SOC2/KMS integration docs available on request.
vivian: :thumbsup: I'll prepare a short doc for pricing + secure deployment options. Sam — include CSV and 3 mitigation bullets for tail spikes.
sam: Will do. Mitigations: warmup, prewarmed KV, raise batch cap, burst autoscale +20%, and model quantization tradeoffs. ETA morning.
aj: If rerun p99 drops under ~350ms with prewarm, we can push Dedicated capacity quote.
jordan_tempest: One more ask — can you run a short test with HSM in the path to show overhead?
luis: We can but HSM will throttle throughput. Plan: 10-min run at 150 QPS to capture delta. I'll schedule and report numbers.
vivian: Great — thanks everyone. I'll sync with Tempest after rerun and post the spreadsheet and SOC2 link here.
